_meta.description: Schema for refactor-review-criteria.json — the criteria `/code-review --refactor` applies in place of the Step 5 charter criteria and the Step 5c domain questions (#3797).

criteria.description: Refactor criteria, applied to every queued file in a refactor run.

lookFor.description: What a reviewer looks for — the text a shard brief carries.

wideScan.description: True: a match in a reviewed file triggers the all-files scan for other sites of the same pattern, and the one proposal lists every site. False: the finding stays local to the file it was found in.
